title: 3.0.0.1 Problems: Small Screen, Prediction of active Insulin, reuse Profile Switch
symptom: On a small screen (Atom XL), some treatments cannot be deleted in the Treatments tab without rotating the screen. The prediction of active insulin curve is missing. Reusing a Profile Switch (even with same profile or changed values) gives an error and sets -6 hours. Long-pressing to expand overview takes long to load.
fix: For the treatment removal issue, the 'Remove' buttons were moved to the options menu in PR #1362 to improve screen usage. For the long-press graph rescale issue, PR #911 was made to fix graph rescale on long press, but it may still have issues in history browser. The profile switch bug was acknowledged as a bug to investigate, but no fix is stated.
evidence_quote: the treatment "Remove" buttons have been moved to the options menu in PR #1362 this makes the result in better screen usage.
